subject.title: fix(feishu): accumulate streamed final delta chunks (#91562)

question: Should maintainers require a rebased repair with live or sanctioned Feishu/CardKit proof, or grant a proof override after maintainer verification?
rationale: The external contributor says they cannot access a Feishu tenant and DeepSeek streaming deployment, while ClawSweeper cannot mark helper console output and mocked tests as sufficient real behavior proof for a visible Feishu channel change.

options.title: Require Repair Plus Proof
options.body: Tighten the helper, rebase onto current main, and require either redacted live Feishu/CardKit evidence or a maintainer-run proof override before merge.

options.title: Override Proof After Verification
options.body: A maintainer with Feishu access can explicitly own the proof gap after verifying the rebased behavior through a sanctioned tenant run.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Feishu Streaming Work
options.body: Pause this branch if maintainers want the latest-token case handled together with the broader Feishu streaming-card reliability tracker.

recommendation.title: Require Repair Plus Proof
recommendation.body: Tighten the helper, rebase onto current main, and require either redacted live Feishu/CardKit evidence or a maintainer-run proof override before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the current live assignee for this PR and have recent Feishu adjacent history, so they are the best available owner for proof override or branch-disposition judgment.
